core_claims.title: AI-driven revenue acceleration is the dominant growth driver
core_claims.statement: Broadcom's revenue growth is significantly influenced by AI semiconductor demand, with management indicating that AI semiconductor revenue is very strong and expected to accelerate, making the durability of AI demand a major factor in future growth
core_claims.why_core: This is the central decision variable for AVGO's growth trajectory and valuation.
